Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE finished game-environment concept painting for Close the Deal, landscape 16:9, largest native resolution available, ideally 3840 x 2160. Single full-bleed image, no border, montage, captions or watermark.
Art direction: a multinational company's 2001 vision of 2025. Elegant optimistic turn-of-the-millennium transport architecture, cool airy white, deliberately sparse graphic masses, finished key-art lighting, restrained painterly architectural visualization. The primary environment reference supplies massing, sky and palette only. The mood plate supplies polish only. Invent the composition and corporate graphics. Suited people use the suit reference's angular, long-limbed fashion proportions, simplified faces and hard cel-shadow masses, small in frame.
Fixed architecture: rectangular office floor 28 m wide, seven 4 m facade bays; 14 m deep open main floor plus a full-width 4 m deep opaque rear service spine. Floor-to-floor 4.5 m, clear soffit 4.3 m. Front street facade has a SOLID OPAQUE WHITE SILL from floor to 1.00 m, then a single uninterrupted near-clear pane from 1.05 m to 4.25 m in each 4 m bay. White columns 0.4 m wide only at the 4 m divisions. Slender top and bottom rails only. No intermediate vertical or horizontal window mullions. Front glass is faintly cool, visually almost absent, never mirrored, frosted or milky.
At centre-back of the OPEN MAIN FLOOR, 10 m back from facade and 4 m in front of service wall, ONE circular spiral stair rises exactly one full clockwise turn per floor. White cylindrical centre column of radius 0.8 m, satin aluminium open wedge treads out to radius 2.6 m. Cage at radius 2.75 m comprises tall flat near-invisible clear glass panels 4.3 m high with fine edge seams, with an open arrival gap on main-floor side. NO opaque stair enclosure. A SINGLE closed RED locked door stands radially ACROSS THE STAIR PATH just after its lower arrival, within the cage, with a tiny lock indicator. It is a stair gate, separate from the three service doors. Clearly show the ascending treads, glass cage and red gate. A dark-suited figure climbs visibly behind clear cage glass.
Rear spine contains three separate opaque rooms WC, STORE, UTIL behind the rear wall, each accessed from main floor by one white 1.2 x 2.4 m service door. Use those tiny labels if seen. One or two small glass meeting rooms sit to the left and right on the main floor, 2.5 m high partitions with open air above them to 4.3 m ceiling. Keep sight through them toward stair entrance. Sparse white desk clusters, dark chairs, early flat-panel monitors, low storage, a beige-grey office photocopier and water cooler create low cover. Wide empty circulation, long sightlines, no maze.
Across the 12 m street gap stands a mirrored rival tower with matching bay rhythm and floor heights, bright white interior backing behind dark suited figures. White-blue block city and saturated blue sky with pale atmospheric haze beyond.
Palette: dominant Paper White #F3F4F4, Silver Grey #C9CED3, restrained Deep Navy #111B38 dark anchors, Corporate Cobalt #244FB9 only as one or two large confident graphic areas, Cyan #20D4E6 only tiny indicators or a thin line. Grey-blue carpet, cheap modular acoustic ceiling tiles and cool fluorescent strips, clean satin aluminium. Red appears only on stair's locked gate. Daylight and cool broad ambient fill, white stays cool white.
Avoid plants, planters, greenery, blinds, mirror glass, frosting, decorative bars across windows, cyberpunk, greeble, exposed pipes, random panels, grime, pastel vaporwave, rounded bubble furniture, tiny scattered blue ornaments, real logos, copied signage. The open spiral stair is the centrepiece and people remain readable through multiple glass layers.

White columns 0.4 m wide only at the 4 m divisions. Slender top and bottom rails only. No intermediate vertical or horizontal window mullions. Front glass is faintly cool, visually almost absent, never mirrored, frosted or milky.
At centre-back of the OPEN MAIN FLOOR, 10 m back from facade and 4 m in front of service wall, ONE circular spiral stair rises exactly one full clockwise turn per floor. White cylindrical centre column of radius 0.8 m, satin aluminium open wedge treads out to radius 2.6 m. Cage at radius 2.75 m comprises tall flat near-invisible clear glass panels 4.3 m high with fine edge seams, with an open arrival gap on main-floor side. NO opaque stair enclosure. A SINGLE closed RED locked door stands radially ACROSS THE STAIR PATH just after its lower arrival, within the cage, with a tiny lock indicator. It is a stair gate, separate from the three service doors. Clearly show the ascending treads, glass cage and red gate. A dark-suited figure climbs visibly behind clear cage glass.
Rear spine contains three separate opaque rooms WC, STORE, UTIL behind the rear wall, each accessed from main floor by one white 1.2 x 2.4 m service door. Use those tiny labels if seen. One or two small glass meeting rooms sit to the left and right on the main floor, 2.5 m high partitions with open air above them to 4.3 m ceiling. Keep sight through them toward stair entrance. Sparse white desk clusters, dark chairs, early flat-panel monitors, low storage, a beige-grey office photocopier and water cooler create low cover. Wide empty circulation, long sightlines, no maze.
Across the 12 m street gap stands a mirrored rival tower with matching bay rhythm and floor heights, bright white interior backing behind dark suited figures. White-blue block city and saturated blue sky with pale atmospheric haze beyond.
Palette: dominant Paper White #F3F4F4, Silver Grey #C9CED3, restrained Deep Navy #111B38 dark anchors, Corporate Cobalt #244FB9 only as one or two large confident graphic areas, Cyan #20D4E6 only tiny indicators or a thin line. Grey-blue carpet, cheap modular acoustic ceiling tiles and cool fluorescent strips, clean satin aluminium. Red appears only on stair's locked gate. Daylight and cool broad ambient fill, white stays cool white.
Avoid plants, planters, greenery, blinds, mirror glass, frosting, decorative bars across windows, cyberpunk, greeble, exposed pipes, random panels, grime, pastel vaporwave, rounded bubble furniture, tiny scattered blue ornaments, real logos, copied signage. The open spiral stair is the centrepiece and people remain readable through multiple glass layers.
